CODELEARN · F5 — ENROLL & MY COURSES

FER202 final assignment (mini LMS) · Function 5 of 11 · Starter = reference of F4 · Suggested time: 90 minutes · Total: 10 marks

1. Overview

Let students join courses. The detail page gets an enrol box: guests are sent to log in first (and come back), students enrol with one click, enrolled students see "Go to course", admins only see a note. Enrolling creates one row in enrollments with an empty progress array. A new protected page /my-courses lists the courses of the logged-in student using _expand=course.

API calls

WhenRequest
open a detail page / My Courses (student)GET /enrollments?userId=2&_expand=course&_sort=enrolledAt&_order=desc
click Enroll — check firstGET /enrollments?userId=2&courseId=4 (already there ⇒ do not post)
click Enroll — createPOST /enrollments { userId, courseId, enrolledAt: "yyyy-mm-dd", completedLessons: [] }

Edge cases

  • Double click / slow network ⇒ still exactly one enrolment (ignore the second click while the first is pending).
  • Log out, log in as someone else ⇒ the previous user's enrolments must not appear (reset the slice on logout).
  • A deleted course in _expand comes back undefined — do not crash.
  • No enrolments ⇒ #no-enrollments with a link to the catalogue.

Main features

  • Enrol · Guest, admin & already enrolled · My Courses page · Redux slice

General requirements

  • Continue from your own F4 code (or the starter, which is the F4 reference). Files marked NEW/EDIT in the tree are the ones this step touches.
  • Create React App (React 18), React Router v6, Redux Toolkit, Axios, React-Bootstrap; json-server 0.17.4 on port 9999 (1.x dropped _expand/_embed).
  • Every HTTP call goes through src/api/*.js (one axiosClient with baseURL: process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL); each API function returns response.data itself — do not rely on interceptors (the auto-grader’s axios does not run them).
  • Keep the ids/classes printed in the brief — the auto-grader uses them. Components never call axios directly.

3. UI wireframe

/courses/4 — enrol box (#enroll-card)          /my-courses  (#my-courses-title "My Courses")

│ student: [   Enroll now     ]│ #enroll-btn    │ [Continue learning]   │ │ [Continue learning]   │ .btn-continue
│ enrolled:[  Go to course  ]  │ #continue-btn  └───────────────────────┘ └───────────────────────┘
│ admin  : "Admins manage …"   │ #admin-note    (none) ⇒ "You have not enrolled in any course yet." #no-enrollments
│ ✔ You are enrolled in …      │ #enroll-success
└─────────────────────────────┘

4. Data model

db.json — 8 collections (json-server 0.17.4, port 9999)

FieldTypeNotes
users{ id, fullName, email, password, role: "admin" | "student", active: boolean, createdAt }email stored lower-case and unique · active:false = locked (cannot log in)
categories{ id, name }Frontend · Backend · Database · Mobile
courses{ id, title, categoryId → categories, level, price, instructor, description, thumbnail, published, createdAt }level ∈ Beginner/Intermediate/Advanced · price in VND (0 = Free) · published:false = draft (admin only)
chapters{ id, courseId → courses, title, order }shown sorted by order as "Chapter 1, 2…"
lessons{ id, chapterId → chapters, courseId → courses, title, order, duration (min), videoUrl, content }videoUrl is a YouTube watch link — convert to /embed/<id> for the iframe
questions{ id, chapterId → chapters, courseId → courses, content, options: string[4], answerIndex: 0..3, explanation }one chapter quiz = all questions of that chapter
enrollments{ id, userId → users, courseId → courses, enrolledAt, completedLessons: number[] }progress lives here (ids of completed lessons, sorted, no duplicates)
results{ id, userId, courseId, chapterId → chapters, score, total, percent, passed, answers: number[], submittedAt }one row per quiz attempt · pass mark 70%

      "completedLessons": [
        1
      ]
    }
  ] /* … 6 rows in db.json */
}

5. Functional requirements

1. Enrol 3 marks

Requirements:

  • Student, not enrolled ⇒ #enroll-btn "Enroll now" (disabled while sending). Success ⇒ the row is posted, the box switches to #continue-btn (link /learn/:courseId) and #enroll-success says "You are enrolled in <title>". Never two rows for the same user + course.

Must use: createAsyncThunk (condition) unwrap()

Example:

an@codelearn.vn on /courses/4 ⇒ POST /enrollments { userId: 2, courseId: 4, completedLessons: [] }

2. Guest, admin & already enrolled 2 marks

Requirements:

  • Guest ⇒ #enroll-btn "Log in to enroll" → /login with state.from ⇒ back on the same course after login. Already enrolled ⇒ #continue-btn. Admin ⇒ #admin-note, no enrol button.

3. My Courses page 3 marks

Requirements:

  • Protected route /my-courses; navbar link #nav-my-courses for students. One .my-course card per enrolment, newest first: .my-course-title, .my-course-enrolled "Enrolled on dd/mm/yyyy", .btn-continue → /learn/:courseId. Empty ⇒ #no-enrollments.

Must use: _expand=course ProtectedRoute

4. Redux slice 2 marks

Requirements:

  • features/enrollments/enrollmentsSlice.js: fetchMyEnrollments(userId), enrollCourse({ userId, courseId }), { items, status, error, enrollStatus }, selector selectEnrollmentByCourse; logout resets it.

Must use: extraReducers addCase(logout)

6. Element ids / classes used by the auto-grader

SelectorPurpose
#enroll-card #enroll-btn #continue-btn #enroll-success #enroll-error #admin-noteenrol box on /courses/:id
#nav-my-courses · #my-courses-title · .my-course#my-course-COURSEID .my-course-title .my-course-enrolled .btn-continue · #no-enrollmentsMy Courses

7. Grading rubric

#FeatureMarks
1Enrol3
2Guest, admin & already enrolled2
3My Courses page3
4Redux slice2
Total10

Common deductions

  • Checking "already enrolled" only in the UI ⇒ duplicates after a double click or with two tabs.
  • Showing every enrolment of every user on My Courses (forgot ?userId=).
  • Hard-coded http://localhost:9999 in components instead of the .env variable.
  • Mutating Redux/React state, or writing localStorage inside a reducer.
  • App crashes (white screen) on an empty list, an unknown id or a server error.

8. Submission

Work in the editor (files on the right) or download the starter, then npm install and npm run dev (json-server :9999 + React :3000) and paste your files back. Press Run for the sample checks and Submit for full grading (hidden checks included). The reference solution of this step unlocks after an Accepted submission.

1. Tổng quan

Cho học viên ghi danh. Trang chi tiết có thêm khối ghi danh: khách bị đưa đi đăng nhập trước (rồi quay lại), học viên ghi danh bằng một cú bấm, người đã ghi danh thấy "Go to course", admin chỉ thấy một ghi chú. Ghi danh tạo một dòng trong enrollments với mảng tiến độ rỗng. Trang có bảo vệ mới /my-courses liệt kê khoá của học viên đang đăng nhập bằng _expand=course.

Lời gọi API

Khi nàoRequest
mở trang chi tiết / My Courses (học viên)GET /enrollments?userId=2&_expand=course&_sort=enrolledAt&_order=desc
bấm Enroll — kiểm trướcGET /enrollments?userId=2&courseId=4 (đã có ⇒ không POST)
bấm Enroll — tạoPOST /enrollments { userId, courseId, enrolledAt: "yyyy-mm-dd", completedLessons: [] }

Trường hợp biên

  • Bấm đúp / mạng chậm ⇒ vẫn đúng một lượt ghi danh (bỏ qua cú bấm thứ hai khi lượt đầu đang chạy).
  • Đăng xuất rồi đăng nhập người khác ⇒ không được hiện khoá của người trước (đặt lại slice khi logout).
  • Khoá đã bị xoá thì _expand trả undefined — không được sập.
  • Chưa ghi danh khoá nào ⇒ #no-enrollments kèm link sang danh mục.

Chức năng chính

  • Ghi danh · Khách, admin & đã ghi danh · Trang My Courses · Slice Redux

Yêu cầu chung

  • Làm tiếp trên code F4 của chính bạn (hoặc starter = lời giải F4). Tệp đánh dấu NEW/EDIT trong cây là tệp bước này đụng tới.
  • Create React App (React 18), React Router v6, Redux Toolkit, Axios, React-Bootstrap; json-server 0.17.4 cổng 9999 (bản 1.x bỏ _expand/_embed).
  • Mọi lời gọi HTTP đi qua src/api/*.js (một axiosClient với baseURL: process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL); mỗi hàm API tự trả response.data — đừng dựa vào interceptor (axios của máy chấm không chạy interceptor).
  • Giữ đúng id/class in trong đề — máy chấm dùng chúng. Component không gọi axios trực tiếp.

5. Yêu cầu chức năng

1. Ghi danh 3 điểm

Yêu cầu:

  • Học viên chưa ghi danh ⇒ #enroll-btn "Enroll now" (khoá khi đang gửi). Thành công ⇒ POST, khối đổi sang #continue-btn (link /learn/:courseId) và #enroll-success ghi "You are enrolled in <tên khoá>". Không bao giờ hai dòng cho cùng người + khoá.

options: React compares references, so the same array means no re-render

lessons.title: What is React?
lessons.content:
React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces from small, reusable components.
In this lesson you see how a React app is just a tree of components that turn data into UI.

lessons.title: Create React App & project structure
lessons.content:
Create the project with npx create-react-app, then walk through public/index.html, src/index.js and src/App.js.
Run it with npm start on http://localhost:3000.

lessons.title: JSX and components
lessons.content:
JSX looks like HTML but compiles to React.createElement calls.
A component is a function that returns JSX; its name must start with a capital letter.

lessons.title: Props vs State
lessons.content:
Props are read-only data passed from a parent; state is data a component owns and changes with its setter.
Changing state re-renders the component.

lessons.title: useState and useEffect
lessons.content:
useState stores a value between renders; useEffect runs side effects such as fetching data after the component renders.
Always list the values the effect uses in its dependency array.

lessons.title: let, const and var
lessons.content: Prefer const, use let when a variable must be reassigned, and avoid var (function scope, hoisting surprises).

lessons.title: Primitive types
lessons.content: string, number, boolean, null, undefined, bigint and symbol — and why typeof null is "object".

lessons.title: Arrow functions and array methods
lessons.content: Write short callbacks with arrow functions and transform data with map, filter and reduce without mutating the original array.

lessons.title: Your first Express server
lessons.content: Install express, create an app and call app.listen(3000). Add a GET route that returns JSON.

lessons.title: Routing & middleware
lessons.content: Split routes with express.Router and write middleware with (req, res, next) for logging and validation.

lessons.title: Building a REST API
lessons.content: Map CRUD to HTTP: GET /items, POST /items, PUT /items/:id, DELETE /items/:id — with the right status codes.

lessons.title: SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY
lessons.content: Choose columns with SELECT, filter rows with WHERE and sort the result with ORDER BY.

lessons.title: JOIN in practice
lessons.content: Combine rows of related tables with INNER JOIN and LEFT JOIN on their keys.

mistakesJson.loi: Chỉ ẩn nút sau khi ghi danh ⇒ bấm đúp kịp gửi hai POST ⇒ hai dòng trùng, tiến độ chia đôi.
Gửi courseId lấy từ useParams() (chuỗi "4") ⇒ db lưu "4", lọc ?courseId=4 vẫn khớp nhưng so === 4 ở client thì không. Dùng course.id (số).
Lấy GET /enrollments (không lọc userId) rồi lọc ở client ⇒ lộ dữ liệu của người khác, chậm khi nhiều dòng.
Không đặt lại slice khi đăng xuất ⇒ đăng nhập tài khoản khác vẫn thấy "Go to course" của người trước trong chốc lát.
Dùng new Date().toISOString() cho enrolledAt rồi hiện bằng toLocaleDateString() ⇒ lệch ngày theo múi giờ; lưu "yyyy-mm-dd" theo giờ máy và định dạng bằng cắt chuỗi.
